text:
maria: Quick async snapshot — pulling together action items for Console Observability roadmap before tomorrow's sync. TL;DR: need owners and ETAs for (1) trace hook rollout for workspace services, (2) error-analysis dashboard v2 (inc. sample-rate UI), (3) retention policy cutover for traces/logs. Pls reply with owner + ETA or blockers. I'll compile.

owen: I can own trace hooks. Blocker: eng-runtime needs a small tracing API change (add context header). ETA EOW unless runtime fixes take longer. @dmitri can you confirm infra capacity?

dmitri: infra looks fine for initial canary but we need to bump ingestion autoscaler for the larger rollout. I have a PR ready to share (autoscaler tweak + limits). ETA mid-next-week for final cut after eng-infra review.

kim: I'll take error-analysis dash v2. Need final metrics list from SRE and a decision on sample-rate controls. Can we freeze the query set by Fri? If not, expect +1 week. pinging @sre-team for metric signoff.

jen: quick ping — dashboard PR #4123 is sitting in review, left a comment about a missing JOIN. @kim can you eyeball so we can move to merge?

maria: thanks. Also retention cutover: who owns migration script and rollback plan? This is critical for our retention milestone.

owen: I'll pair with infra on the migration script. For rollback we need a read-only toggle in the ingest service; sketch below: 

```
# dry-run
scripts/retention_migrate --dry-run --since=2023-10-01
# cutover
scripts/retention_migrate --apply --batch-size=5000
```

I'll open the PR with tests and a telemetry flag to validate.

dmitri: noted. I'll review the scripts once posted and add the autoscaler change. Also let's emit a metric `ingest.retention_migrate.progress` so SRE can monitor.

deploy-bot: canary deploy obs-trace-hook v0.12 succeeded in prod-canary (3/3 pods). :rocket:

maria: ok compiling. Action items I'm logging: 1) Trace hooks owner=owen ETA=EOW (depends runtime PR) 2) Error dash owner=kim ETA=Fri freeze needed 3) Retention migration owner=owen+dmitri ETA=mid-next-week 4) Dashboard PR review owner=kim/jen ETA=tomorrow. If anything is off or your ETA changes reply here — I'll post consolidated snapshot by 10:00 PT.

kim: ack, will review PR and confirm queries by Thu.

dmitri: ack, will review migration PR and autoscaler patch tomorrow morning.

jen: ack — I'll nudge reviewer and will merge after kim signoff. :+1:

maria: thanks all. If no objections I'll close this thread after the snapshot post. :white_check_mark:
